titleEn: Quantum superposition: when a particle can exist in several states
summaryEn:
In the everyday world, a coin lying on a table can only be heads or tails. But in the quantum world, particles such as electrons or photons can exist in a superposition of several states before a measurement yields a specific result.

This strange phenomenon is called quantum superposition, one of the foundational principles of quantum mechanics. Superpositions of atoms have been created and observed in the laboratory.
